question.name: Question 2
question.problem:
Suppose $T:V\to W$ is a linear map and $B=\{{b}_{1},{b}_{2},{b}_{3}\}$ and $C=\{{c}_{1},{c}_{2}\}$ are the bases of the vector spaces $V$ and $W$, respectively. Find the matrix $[T]_{B|C}$ of the map $T$ relative to these bases, if 

$$
[T({b}_{1})]_{C}=[\begin{aligned}-4 \\ 8\end{aligned}],\,[T({b}_{2})]_{C}=[\begin{aligned}6 \\ -1\end{aligned}],\,[T({b}_{3})]_{C}=[\begin{aligned}8 \\ -3\end{aligned}].
$$
question.worked_solution:
Recall that $[T]_{B|C}$ is the matrix whose columns are the coordinates of the vectors $T({b}_{1}),$ $T({b}_{2}),$ and $T({b}_{3})$ relative to the basis $C.$ Therefore,

$$
[\begin{aligned}-4 & 6 & 8 \\ 8 & -1 & -3\end{aligned}].
$$

question.raw_html:
2.?

Suppose T:V→W is a linear map and B={b1,b2,b3} and C={c1,c2} are the bases of the vector spaces V and W, respectively. Find the matrix [T]B|C of the map T relative to these bases, if [T(b1)]C=[−48],[T(b2)]C=[6−1],[T(b3)]C=[8−3].

feedback.worked_solution:
Recall that $[T]_{B|C}$ is the matrix whose columns are the coordinates of the vectors $T({b}_{1}),$ $T({b}_{2}),$ and $T({b}_{3})$ relative to the basis $C.$ Therefore,

$$
[\begin{aligned}-4 & 6 & 8 \\ 8 & -1 & -3\end{aligned}].
$$
